guard.firstDraft:
Tum sahi pakad rahi ho: sirf peels aur leaves compost bante hain; foil ya plastic waisa hi reh sakta hai.

The school puts vegetable peels, dry leaves and one plastic spoon into a compost pit and covers it with soil. Predict what you will find when you dig it up after two months.

end.summary:
- Discussed keeping benches and floors clean and putting tiffin waste in bins.
- Practised sorting wet waste for the green bin and dry waste, including wrappers and foil, for the blue bin.
- Discussed that compost needs air/oxygen and microbes.
- Plastic and foil in compost misconception remained at the end; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting food scraps and fruit peels into wet waste and wrappers, chips packets, and foil into dry waste. They explained that separating wet and dry waste helps composting, and recalled that compost needs air, but they continued to mix up whether plastic and foil rot into soil. At home, ask Anika to sort a few clean household waste items and explain which ones can rot and which ones cannot.
